Bill.BriefDescription: Exempting future state transportation projects from state and local sales and use tax.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to exempting future state transportation projectsfrom state and local sales and use tax; adding a new section to chapter82.08 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 82.12 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Any person, including the department of transportation and anyprivate entity or entities, is exempt from taxes on the sitepreparation for state transportation projects, the construction ofstate transportation projects, the acquisition of any related machineryand equipment that becomes a part of state transportation projects, andthe rental of equipment for use in state transportation projects.Application must be made to the department in a form and mannerprescribed by the department. The application must contain informationregarding estimated or actual costs, time schedules for completion andoperation, and other information required by the department. Thedepartment must approve the application within sixty days if it meetsthe requirements of this section. p. 1 HB 1985 (2) The department must issue a sales and use tax exemptioncertificate for state and local sales and use taxes due under thischapter and chapters 82.12 and 82.14 RCW on the project. (3) Applications and any other information received by thedepartment under this section are not confidential and are subject todisclosure. (4) The exemption authorized under this section applies to: (a) Any project where construction is initiated on or after theeffective date of this section and the project is funded with newtransportation revenues adopted on or after the effective date of thissection; and (b) Any project where construction is initiated on or after July 1,2017, and the project is funded with revenues adopted before theeffective date of this section.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) This chapter does not apply to the use of machinery andequipment that becomes a part of a state transportation project or theuse of rental equipment for use in a state transportation project. (2) The application requirements and other conditions under section1 of this act apply to this section.
